The '''Kailion sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the sector included [[Bovo Yagen (planet)|Bovo Yagen]], [[Kailion]] and [[Tlactehon]].
